TSIOQUE is a very good point and click, adventure game and it's done by the same people that made tormentum dark sorrow, now then let's talk about the story. Once upon a time in a faraway land there lived a beautiful queen with a princess at hand, everything was peace and everything was right until a deadly Phoenix rose and caused a great fright, so the queen set off to do battle with the beast leaving the princess alone, thinking she would be alright. But deep in the castle the sorcerer there did plan to overthrow the queen and take over the land, so the princess now captured must escape and must fight to free the land of this deadly plight.

Alright the likes, the story is really good I love the fairy tale theme of it, it's cozy yet has a slight dark edge to it, I particularly like the messaging of responsibility, helping people and friendship these are classic lessons to learn, it also has a bit dark comedy in it as well. The hand drawn graphic art style is really good with a very good uses of colors and designs, it kind of reminds me a little bit of this old video game Dragon's lair.

The levels are very good like I said I love the hand-drawn art style it has a sort of Dragon's lair quality to it, it’s very detailed and each part of the castle is quite distinct and filled with little odds and ends that just make this place come to life that you just want to stop and stare at everything.

The gameplay is good it's a simple point and click game, pick up items in order and solve puzzles to progress through the game nothing really too complicated, there's also some nice little mini games to play. The puzzles for the most part are pretty good with some nice clues on how to solve them. 

The characters are okay and they're pretty simple, personally I like the princess she was adorable and I especially like her determined face throughout the game. The music is very good definitely has a nice cozy feeling that fits with this game really well. The voice acting was good from the evil sorcerer to the narrator.

Alright the dislikes, the game is a bit short you can probably beat it in 3 hours or less if you're not going after achievements, the price is also a little high for such a short game, but to be fair I can understand it. Also the stitching mini game and the mirror puzzle is a little bit annoying.

So with that said TSIOQUE is a very good point and click, adventure game and it's done by the same people that made tormentum dark sorrow, it has a really good story, really good hand drawn graphic art style and good gameplay, so I recommend this game if you're looking for a good point and click adventure game this could be for you I do suggest maybe getting it on sale though.

Tsioque uzun zamandır oynadığım en iyi bağımsız oyun. Çok önce satın almıştım ancak nedense elim bir türlü gitmemişti. Hata etmişim. Karşımızda bir çeşit Point & Click var. "Bir çeşit" tabirini kullandım zira Tsioque daha ziyade Point & Click işleyişini kullanan bir puzzle oyunu. Diyalog yok, nesneleri inceleme yok, inventory'de bulunan eşyaları birleştirme yok ve yalnızca tek bir tıklama komutu var. Kısacası epey minimalist bir arayüz söz konusu. Buna rağmen oyun çok ama çok başarılı, asla sıkılmıyorsunuz ve bulmacalar her ne kadar pek zor olmasalar da hikayenin işleyişini sağladıkları için son derece tatmin ediciler.

Hikayeden bahsetmek gerekirse... Bir şato, bir kraliçe, bir prenses ve hain bir büyücü desem? Evet öykü klişe ([spoiler] Plot twist hariç [/spoiler]). Ama görsellik muhteşem. Ses tasarımı da. Kontroller ağır aksak değil, refleks kullanmanız gereken birkaç kısımda da sabır testine tabi tutulmuyorsunuz. Oyun kesinlikle bağımsız yapımcı işi gibi değil. Kısa süresi dışında... Sanırım oyunla ilgili eleştirebileceğim tek konu bu ama şunu da belirtmem gerekir ki bu kısa süreyi gayet dolu dolu geçiriyorsunuz, kesinlikle yavaş bir oyun değil.

Neticede Tsioque hem Point & Click, hem de puzzle sevenlere şiddetle tavsiyemdir.

就像翻开一本充满想象色彩的童话书，强大的“女王”带兵出征迎击凤凰，勇敢正义的“公主齐奥克”突破重重险阻要打破“巫师”的邪恶计划。公主的表情总是坚毅果敢，每次行动都是勇敢与智慧并存的冒险。

很有意思的是一些细节，比如“巫师在城堡贴满了要安静的警告”、“原来洞穴里的怪状岩石变成了洗衣机”、“巨龙的嘴不会喷火但会像吸尘器一样暴风吸入”、“魔镜很神奇还可以换台调节音量”、“解救的伙伴们都是宠物和玩具”……等等。结局在各种细枝末节中得以揭示，揭幕那一刻所有疑点都有了解释。

我想说，虽然童话还是回归了现实，但“公主齐奥克”的故事还会继续～

Großartiges kleines Abenteuer für einen gemütlichen comfy Spielabend, mit einem unerwarteten und herzerwärmenden wohligen Ende. Besondere Skills oder viel Spielerfahrung braucht man absolut nicht, ist denke ich für jedermann machbar, wenn man ein wenig Geduld aufbringt und detailverliebt ist. Danke an die Entwickler :D

Tsioque is a short point-and-click adventure game (takes about 3–4 hours) with beautiful hand-drawn animations. The music and sound effects work great with the fairytale setting. Princess Tsioque is trapped by an evil wizard and needs to escape his castle. She has a major attitude problem, but that made her entertaining to play as. The story is well written and got ridiculous enough to make me laugh out loud.

You get the usual point-and-click gameplay. You grab objects, combine them in clever ways, and use them to solve problems. There are also some timed action scenes that need quick reflexes. Some can be frustrating since you're mostly guessing, but you can skip them if you get stuck. I liked the few mini-games like controlling a sewing needle or casting magic spells. They created a bit of variety.

It's a really fun little game, and at 5€ on sale it was totally worth it.
